alt: 男孩仔細替花盆繫緞帶、貼貝殼，盆裡土壤卻乾裂、葉子低垂；女孩一手示意澆水壺，一手托起枯萎的葉片。
meaning: 指不求事物的根本大端，只重視微末小節。
scene_prompt: 成語：採『忽略根本要務，只忙著微小裝飾』，重點是養植物最需要的澆水被擱置，孩子卻全心裝飾花盆。台灣國小自然教室，一名孩子拿著細緞帶與小貝殼，專心把花盆外緣裝飾得華麗漂亮，滿意地欣賞花盆。盆裡的植物葉片已明顯下垂，泥土乾裂；裝滿水的小澆水壺就在旁邊，完全沒用過。另一位同學扶著下垂的葉子，望向澆水壺，露出焦急提醒的表情。畫面把乾燥根土與過度裝飾並置，清楚表達主要需求被忽略，不畫植物被裝飾壓壞或裝飾本身造成傷害。
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website for elementary students in Taiwan. Landscape 3:2. Characters: Taiwanese (East Asian) children and adults drawn in a gentle Japanese anime picture-book style, natural expressions, age-appropriate child proportions (elementary-school kids look 7-12 years old). Setting: present-day Taiwan (Taiwanese schools, streets, homes, parks). Taiwanese school uniform = plain polo shirt or white shirt with shorts/skirt, or sports PE uniform; NO red neckerchief, NO red scarf. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain on warm ivory textured paper, paper texture visible.
